/**
 * @name Command injection via subprocess
 * @description User-controlled input flowing into subprocess execution may lead to command injection
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/virtualenv-command-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module CommandInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    source instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode or
    source = API::moduleImport("sys").getMember("argv").getAValueReachableFromSource()
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(SystemCommandExecution cmd |
      sink = cmd.getCommand()
    )
  }
}

module CommandInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CommandInjectionConfig>;
import CommandInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CommandInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Command injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: User-controlled input flowing into subprocess execution may lead to command injection

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
 * @description User-controlled URLs in HTTP requests may lead to SSRF attacks
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/virtualenv-ssrf
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module SSRFConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    source instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode or
    source = API::moduleImport("sys").getMember("argv").getAValueReachableFromSource()
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      (
        call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "Request"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember(["request", "urlopen"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "head", "options", "patch", "request"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("http").getMember("client").getMember(["HTTPConnection", "HTTPSConnection"]).getACall()
      ) and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module SSRFFlow = TaintTracking::Global<SSRFConfig>;
import SSRFFlow::PathGraph

from SSRFFlow::PathNode source, SSRFFlow::PathNode sink
where SSRFFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential SSRF from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: User-controlled URLs in HTTP requests that could lead to SSRF

/**
 * @name Arbitrary file write
 * @description User-controlled input flowing into file write operations may allow arbitrary file writes
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/virtualenv-arbitrary-file-write
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module ArbitraryFileWriteConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    source instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode or
    source = API::moduleImport("sys").getMember("argv").getAValueReachableFromSource()
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      (
        call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall() or
        call = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember("write_text").getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember("write_bytes").getACall()
      ) and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module ArbitraryFileWriteFlow = TaintTracking::Global<ArbitraryFileWriteConfig>;
import ArbitraryFileWriteFlow::PathGraph

from ArbitraryFileWriteFlow::PathNode source, ArbitraryFileWriteFlow::PathNode sink
where ArbitraryFileWriteFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Arbitrary file write from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: User-controlled input flowing into file write operations may allow arbitrary file writes

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Symlink following vulnerability
 * @description Following symlinks without validation can lead to unauthorized file access
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/virtualenv-symlink-following
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-59
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["symlink", "link", "readlink"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember("symlink_to").getACall()
select call, "Symlink operation that may be vulnerable to race conditions."
findings.hypothesis: Symlink operations that could lead to race conditions or unauthorized access

message.text: Symlink operation that may be vulnerable to race conditions.
Symlink operation that may be vulnerable to race conditions.
